class.name: VFXBindings
class.brief_description: Maps gameplay events to VFX presets, graphs and sequences.
class.description: [VFXBindings] is a data registry from event types ([code]"hit"[/code], [code]"lightning_struck"[/code], ...) to effects. Spawning is delegated to a [Callable] with the signature [code]spawn(effect: String, position: Vector3, params: Dictionary)[/code], which keeps the registry independent of how effects are created. Typically the callable calls [method VFXPresets.spawn]. A binding spec supports these keys: [code]effect[/code] (name passed to the spawn callable), [code]sequence[/code] (name of a registered sequence), [code]offset[/code] ([Vector3]), [code]min_interval[/code] (throttle in seconds, measured by [method tick]) and [code]params[/code]. Each parameter is either a constant or a mapping [code]{"from": payload_key, "scale": 1.0, "offset": 0.0, "default": 0.0, "min": ..., "max": ...}[/code] resolved against the event payload. Events from the gameplay_fx module can be fed in with [method handle_cue_events], which takes the array returned by [code]GameplayCueQueue.take_events()[/code]. [codeblock] var bindings := VFXBindings.new() bindings.register_binding("lightning_struck", {"effect": "lightning_sparks", "params": {"level": {"from": "quality", "default": 2}}}) bindings.handle({"type": "lightning_struck", "position": pos, "payload": {"quality": 3}}, spawn_callable) [/codeblock]

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all bindings, sequences, running sequences and throttle history, and resets the clock.

method.name: get_active_sequence_count
method.description: Returns the number of sequences started by [method handle] that have not finished.

method.name: get_binding_count
method.description: Returns the total number of registered binding specs.

method.name: get_clock
method.description: Returns the time accumulated by [method tick].

method.name: handle
method.description: Dispatches [param event] ([code]{"type": String, "position": Vector3, "payload": Dictionary}[/code]; without [code]payload[/code] the event itself is the payload). Returns how many effects or sequences were started.

method.name: handle_cue_events
method.description: Feeds events drained from a [code]GameplayCueQueue[/code] into [method handle]. Each cue [code]{tag, event, stacks, magnitude, priority, count}[/code] is dispatched as an event whose type is the cue tag for [code]"started"[/code] and [code]"executed"[/code] cues, or [code]"<tag>:stopped"[/code] for [code]"stopped"[/code] cues; [code]"updated"[/code] cues are skipped. The cue fields are the payload and [param position] is the event position. Returns the number of effects started.

method.name: has_binding
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if at least one binding is registered for [param event_type].

method.name: make_sequence
method.description: Creates a [VFXSequence] from the registered sequence [param name], or returns [code]null[/code] if it does not exist.

method.name: map_params
method.description: Resolves a parameter [param mapping] against [param payload]. Numeric values are scaled, offset and clamped; other values pass through.

method.name: register_binding
method.description: Adds a binding spec for [param event_type]. Several specs may share one event type.

method.name: register_sequence
method.description: Registers a sequence. Entries are [code]{"t": float, "effect": String, "offset": Vector3, "params": Dictionary}[/code].

method.name: tick
method.description: Advances the clock used for [code]min_interval[/code] and all sequences started by [method handle]; finished sequences are dropped.
